name: google-vids-automation
description: HT Studio desktop automation for Google Vids video creation workflows
author: HT Studio

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/license-config.json','build/src/license-config.json')"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run clean:package && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --win portable --config.directories.output=%TEMP%\ht-vids-studio-pack && node scripts/finalize-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:setup: npm run clean:package && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config.directories.output=%TEMP%\ht-vids-studio-pack --config.artifactName=HT-Vids-Studio-Setup-${version}-Windows-x64.${ext} && node scripts/finalize-package.mjs
